solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Man very curious about slogan sung in fleet

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other
curious means odd or strange, so the letters of the two words are taken in a strange order

parts.note: a chant is a slogan sung by a crowd

explanation.surface: A peculiar man's football-style chant is heard throughout the navy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curious' gives MERNAVY; 'about' wraps that round the slogan, so the chant sits in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: The merchant navy is a nation's fleet of commercial shipping, as opposed to warships.

clue.text: Singer, a Jackson, in pop band in Mali, performing

indicators.note: in signals that one piece sits within the other
performing suggests acting out or playing about, so the letters of the country are rearranged

parts.note: A-ha is the Norwegian pop band behind Take On Me

explanation.surface: A singer called Jackson appears with a pop group at a concert in Mali.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' gives MLIA, which 'in' opens up for the band; the second 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahalia Jackson was the celebrated American gospel singer, so she is a singer surnamed Jackson.

clue.text: Batter and break bulwark

parts.note: to batter is to ram, as with a battering ram
to break is to part, to separate

explanation.surface: An instruction to smash and breach a defensive wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampart is a defensive wall or embankment, a synonym for a bulwark.

clue.text: Browbeaten ambassador knight kissed quickly

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador
N is the chess notation for a knight
to peck is to give a quick kiss

explanation.surface: An intimidated diplomat is given a hasty kiss by a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: HE stands for His Excellency, the form of address for an ambassador.
explanation.definitionFit: A henpecked person is nagged and dominated, i.e. browbeaten, usually by a partner.

clue.text: Don overturned tennis call

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue means the word is turned upside down, read from bottom to top

parts.note: to don clothes is to put them on

explanation.surface: A university don has rejected an umpire's call at tennis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don' looks like a university teacher, but it is the verb to put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Umpires call out that the ball was played after its second bounce, an expression heard in tennis and similar racket games.

clue.text: Ideas on it son scuppered

indicators.note: scuppered means wrecked, so the letters of the three words are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Plans that rested on the boy were ruined by him.
explanation.definitionFit: Notions are thoughts or concepts, a direct synonym for ideas.

clue.text: Price e.g. of outlet incorporated therein

indicators.note: therein means inside it, so one piece is placed within the outlet

parts.note: a vent is an outlet for air or gas

explanation.surface: Seems to describe the cost of a shop outlet being built into the business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Price' is not money but the horror actor Vincent Price; 'therein' sets the abbreviation inside the outlet.
explanation.definitionFit: Vincent Price was the American film actor, so Price is an example of someone with that first name.

clue.text: Station in London being supplied with choice fruit

parts.note: Victoria is a major London railway terminus
plum, as in a plum job, means choice or desirable

explanation.surface: A London railway station is stocked with high-quality fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'choice fruit' looks like one phrase, but 'choice' gives PLUM and 'fruit' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a well-known English variety of dessert plum, red and sweet.

clue.text: Animal watering hole in which smell's appalling at first

indicators.note: in which says the following pieces sit inside the watering hole

parts.note: a pub or inn is jokingly called a watering hole
hum is British slang for a bad smell; the 's is 'is', a link

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of the word appalling

explanation.surface: A pub where an animal smell is dreadful from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Animal' reads as a noun but is an adjective meaning brutish. HUM is British slang for a stink.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal as an adjective means beastly or brutish, a sense close to cruel and lacking humanity.

clue.text: Liner hit it, an iceberg somewhat hidden

indicators.note: somewhat hidden says part of the phrase conceals the answer within it

explanation.surface: The famous ship struck an iceberg, mostly concealed below the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The ship that sank in 1912 was an ocean liner of the White Star Line.

clue.text: Excitedly watch bee and a big butterfly

indicators.note: excitedly suggests agitation, so the letters of the phrase are jumbled

explanation.surface: An instruction to watch eagerly as a bee and a large butterfly flutter.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a common white butterfly whose caterpillars eat brassicas.

clue.text: Husbandry up to the time of elderliness

parts.note: till means until, up to the time of
age is old age, elderliness

explanation.surface: Farming continued until old age.
explanation.definitionFit: Tillage is the cultivation of land, a part of husbandry in its farming sense.

clue.text: Saw king finished in lead

indicators.note: in places the king and finished inside the lead symbol

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king
over means finished or ended

explanation.surface: A tool belonging to a king is completed in lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a tool or a past tense, but it is a noun meaning a saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim, the same as a proverb.

clue.text: Hit back about law

parts.note: re means about or concerning
an act of parliament is a law

explanation.surface: Retaliating on account of a piece of legislation.
explanation.definitionFit: To hit back is to respond in kind, i.e. to respond to something done to you.

clue.text: Hindu text discovered in ark, a must for translation by head of academy

indicators.note: for translation suggests the words are put into another form, so their letters are rearranged
head of takes the opening letter of the word academy

explanation.surface: A sacred book found on the ark is essential reading for a college principal to translate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for translation' rearranges ARKAMUST, and the A from 'head of academy' follows it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kama Sutra is an ancient Sanskrit treatise on love, a Hindu text.

clue.text: Overcoming it, Germans reassembled

indicators.note: reassembled means put together again in a different order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Germans regrouping and getting the better of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Mastering a problem means conquering or getting on top of it.

clue.text: Advance payments required to secure audio player? The direct opposite

indicators.note: to secure means to hold fast, so the payments enclose the player

parts.note: antes are stakes paid in advance in poker
the iPod is Apple's portable music player

explanation.surface: Deposits demanded before someone can buy a music player.
explanation.walkthrough: ANTES are stakes put up before play in poker.
explanation.definitionFit: The antipodes are places diametrically opposite on the globe, hence anything directly opposite.

clue.text: Wrong about working round place in Ontario

indicators.note: about says the wrong goes round the working piece

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
on means working, as a machine that is switched on
O looks round, like a ring

explanation.surface: A mistake about operating around somewhere in Canada.
explanation.walkthrough: TORT is the legal term for a civil wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Toronto is the provincial capital and largest city of Ontario.

clue.text: Overcome dire peril crossing Virginia

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the jumbled letters span the state
dire means dreadful, so the letters of the word peril are thrown into disorder

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: Beating terrible danger during a journey across Virginia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dire' gives PREIL, and 'crossing' has the state abbreviation sitting across its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevail is to win through, to triumph, so it can replace overcome used without an object.

clue.text: Man's lost Wings hit of long ago?

indicators.note: lost Wings means the word drops its two outside letters, its wings

parts.note: a man in the army is a soldier, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: Seems to say Paul McCartney's band Wings has lost an old chart hit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wings' looks like McCartney's band but means the outer letters, which SOLDIER loses.
explanation.definitionFit: An old song or film still remembered is called by this informal word for a past hit.

clue.text: Direct extra to spot

parts.note: an over is extra, as in left over
to spot is to see

explanation.surface: An instruction to find something additional.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to supervise, to direct work or workers.

clue.text: Cavalryman, a stupid person to support Democrat as well as Republican

indicators.note: to support in a down clue means to sit below the other pieces

parts.note: D stands for Democrat in US politics
R stands for Republican in US politics
a goon is a stupid person or oaf

explanation.surface: A soldier on horseback, a fool who backs both US parties.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragoon is a mounted soldier, historically a mounted infantryman, hence a cavalryman.

clue.text: Theft: criminal nearly caught inside

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation within the jumbled letters
criminal suggests something crooked, so the letters of the word are twisted

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A thief was very nearly caught inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' gives LARENY, and 'inside' slips the cricket abbreviation into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Larceny is the legal term for stealing, i.e. theft.

clue.text: Long story about Spain

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the story goes round the letter

parts.note: a yarn is a story
E is the international vehicle registration for Spain

explanation.surface: A lengthy tale about Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective but is the verb to long for.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn is to long for something, the verb sense.

clue.text: Claptrap from detective was hard to follow

indicators.note: to follow says the hard abbreviation comes after the other pieces

parts.note: a private eye is a detective
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Rubbish from a detective was difficult to keep up with.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyewash is nonsense or humbug, an informal synonym for claptrap.

clue.text: Helena's here in Piedmont, a native

indicators.note: in says the answer lies within the run of letters in the phrase

explanation.surface: Someone called Helena is in Piedmont, a person born there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Helena' seems a woman's name but is the state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Helena is the capital city of Montana, so that state is where Helena is.

clue.text: Trendy type touring hospital, briefly

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy

indicators.note: touring means travelling around, so the type goes round the hospital letter

parts.note: a sort is a type or kind

explanation.surface: A fashionable person on a hospital tour, in a nutshell.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrase means to sum up concisely, the same sense as briefly.

clue.text: Pitching on new lawn

parts.note: bowling in cricket is pitching the ball to the batsman
green means new or inexperienced

explanation.surface: Throwing a ball onto freshly laid turf.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowling green is a closely mown lawn on which the game of bowls is played.
